base: E1 (Issue #141, PR #145) commit 568b4db; M1 frozen design

m1_frozen_design.lineage: E-consistent per-column (experimental prototype; not adoptable for the manuscript)

seeds.rule: split = base + r; thin = base + 10 r + regime_index; model = base + r (shared by all four fits of replicate r)

m1_frozen_design.primary: Procrustes RMSE_Z (rotation only); delta_RMSE_Z = wrong - correct
secondary: held-out Bernoulli plug-in mean log score (run_heldout_k_selection_pilot.heldout_bernoulli_mean_log_score)
m1_frozen_design.x_metric: not computed (no cross-family raw likelihood ranking)
m1_frozen_design.success_criterion: none on the sign of delta; any direction is a valid result

seed_separation: em_runner.run_em_experimental(init_seed, mc_seed): init_seed -> initialize_params only, mc_seed -> E-step rng only; defaults to seed (unchanged behaviour)
arms_share: data, masks, init seed, MC seed (EM paths differ by likelihood)

smoke_rule.rule: MATCH if every compared quantity of the 4 smoke fits equals the E1 artifact within 1e-12; otherwise MISMATCH and the full run is refused

primary: mode paired delta RMSE_Z per cell; MC / init contrasts and interaction
estimators: last / mean5 / mode as E1 (mode Z0 = last, grad_tol 1e-8, max_iter 200)
mode_non_ok_policy: never imputed; a replicate is complete only if all 8 fits are usable

interpretation_guide.quantities: mc = median over replicates of mean(|D_AB-D_AA|, |D_BB-D_BA|); init = median of mean(|D_BA-D_AA|, |D_BB-D_AB|); mode estimator
interpretation_guide.small: both mc and init < 0.01 (about 1/8 of the E1 sparse effect ~0.08)
interpretation_guide.note: descriptive guide only; not a test and not a general decomposition

limitation: two levels per factor, 20 replicates: no general variance decomposition or causal claim
